tools.name: search_skills
tools.description: Search the tested agent skill files for sale (free). Give a plain-language query (for example: sound less like ChatGPT), or filter by category, tag or language, or combine them. With a query the results come ranked by relevance; without one you get the featured skills first. Each card has match_reas

tools.name: list_categories
tools.description: List the twelve skill categories (free) with a short introduction and how many skills are listed in each. Use a slug as the category filter of search_skills.

tools.name: get_skill
tools.description: Get one skill card (free) plus the exact x402 payment_required body for its one-time purchase of the SKILL.md file, and how_to_buy. Price is price_usd on the card. Buying is over HTTP; MCP does not take payments.

tools.name: redownload_skill
tools.description: Re-download the SKILL.md file you already bought (free), using the token from your purchase receipt. Always returns the current version of the skill.
